About

Residential Plumbing

Dealing with home plumbing issues can be stressful, but it doesn't have to be! At Up To Code Plumbing, we treat you and your home with the exact same care and respect as our own family. You can always count on us for straightforward, honest recommendations designed for your daily ease of use and the long-term longevity of your plumbing system—we are here to solve your problems, not to upsell you. Whether you need an urgent repair or a fixture upgrade, we deliver expert solutions backed by a 1-year guarantee on our plumbing work and a solid 6-month guarantee on drain cleaning.

Investors, Landlords & Property Managers:

We have simplified volume work by creating an Auto-Approval and Auto-Payment Form. Answer a few short questions to get work done FAST!

Open Auto-Approval Form
What We
Offer

01

Drain Cleaning & Unclogging

Stubborn clogs can disrupt your whole day, but we're here to help get things flowing smoothly again quickly and safely. We'll clear your pipes with the utmost care, and for your total peace of mind, we back all of our drain cleaning services with a solid 6-month guarantee.

03

Leak Detection & Pipe Repair

Hidden leaks can be stressful, but you can count on us to quickly find and fix them before they cause major headaches. We treat your home with respect while we work, and all of our pipe repair solutions are fully backed by our 1-year guarantee.

05

Sewer Repair & Camera Inspections

Sewer troubles can feel overwhelming, but we take the guesswork out of it with our advanced camera technology. We'll show you exactly what's going on underground and provide a straightforward, honest repair plan to get your system back in top shape safely.

02

Water Heater Repair & Installation

Cold showers are no fun for anyone! Whether your current water heater just needs a little TLC or it's time for an energy-efficient upgrade, we'll give you honest advice on what makes the most sense for your home's daily use—never trying to upsell you on something you don't need.

04

Bathroom & Kitchen Fixtures
 

From fixing that annoyingly persistent dripping faucet to helping you install beautiful new sinks, toilets, and showerheads, we handle the details so you don't have to. We focus on providing high-quality, long-lasting solutions that make your daily routine easier​

06

Gas Line Installation & Repair

When it comes to your home's gas lines, your family's safety is our absolute highest priority. Whether you're hooking up a new gas stove or need an urgent repair, our expert team ensures every single connection is perfectly secure and 100% up to code.

Our Plumbing Services
Drain & Sewer Cleaning
Water Heater Repair & Replacement
Water Line & Leak Repair
Gas Line Installation & Repair

About

Commercial Plumbing

Running a business is demanding enough without having to stress over plumbing issues. At Up To Code Plumbing, we treat your facility with the exact same care and urgency as we would our own business. We know that plumbing problems mean unwanted downtime, so we focus on getting your operations back up and running smoothly and safely. You can always count on our team for straightforward, honest recommendations designed for the heavy-duty demands and long-term longevity of your commercial systems—we are here to solve your problems, not to upsell you. Whether you need an urgent repair or a major installation, we deliver expert, code-compliant solutions backed by a 90-day guarantee on our plumbing work and a 30-day guarantee on commercial drain cleaning.

Commercial Client Fast-Track Portal

Skip the paperwork and prevent downtime. Pre-authorize your account and payments here so we can get your urgent repairs and code violations on the schedule faster.

Open Fast-Track Form
What We
Offer

01

Commercial Drain Cleaning

Keeping your business running means keeping your pipes totally clear. We use heavy-duty commercial equipment to safely and effectively clear away stubborn blockages before they cause major disruptions. We know downtime costs you money, so we work efficiently to get things flowing smoothly again and back our commercial drain services with a solid 30-day guarantee.

03

Commercial Water Heaters
 

Whether you run a busy restaurant, a salon, or a large office building, reliable hot water is an absolute must. We provide honest, straightforward advice for repairing or upgrading your heavy-duty commercial water heaters, always focusing on maximum efficiency and backed by our 90-day plumbing guarantee.

05

Public Restroom Plumbing

High-traffic commercial restrooms take a beating, which can lead to frustrating 'out of order' signs for your customers. From repairing heavy-duty commercial toilets to installing sanitary touchless fixtures, we deliver highly durable solutions proudly backed by our 90-day plumbing guarantee.

02

Backflow Testing & Repair

Code compliance is critical for any business, and backflow prevention keeps our community's water safe. We handle your required annual testing, certifications, and any necessary repairs quickly and honestly, taking the stress off your plate and keeping your facility 100% up to code.

​

​

​

04

Commercial Gas Line Services

From restaurant kitchens to heavy-duty heating equipment, your facility's gas lines demand expert care. We ensure every single commercial gas installation and repair is perfectly secure and 100% up to code, prioritizing the absolute safety of your employees, customers, and property.

06

Commercial Leak Detection & Pipe Repair

A hidden leak can cause major disruptions to your daily operations and damage your property. We use advanced diagnostics to quickly locate and repair compromised pipes, treating your building with respect and backing our repair work with our solid 90-day guarantee.

About

About Up to Code Plumbing

Experienced Team

Established in 2025 by Buffalo, New York natives Ken and Amanda Carrick, Up to Code Plumbing has rapidly become the premier plumbing service in Wichita. Our company was meticulously crafted, selecting only the finest elements from a multitude of plumbing businesses to create an almost flawless enterprise. We offer comprehensive solutions for every plumbing requirement, ensuring our specialists meet the utmost standards. By incorporating cutting-edge technology, we have refined the customer experience from the first contact with our office to the completion of payment. We stand behind our work with the industry's leading guarantee.

What To Expect

We have several easy ways to book service with us. You can call us at (316) 400-PLUM, text us at (316) 400-7586, or click the "Book An Appointment" button at the top of this page

​​

When our technician arrives in a fully wrapped vehicle, you'll be given up-front and honest pricing before any work is done. After the work is completed, our technician will collect payment.

​

We can accept cash, check, card, Apple Pay, Google Pay, Venmo, Cash App, and PayPal. We also offer financing.

A Word From The Owner

Hello! I'm Ken Carrick, master plumber and the owner of Up to Code Plumbing. I've been plumbing since 2013, including more than ten years of hands-on experience in western New York, and I take pride in offering a glimpse into the exceptional standards and professionalism that I've maintained during my career. Rest assured, I hold my entire staff to the same standards.

​​

Thank you so much for your interest in Up to Code Plumbing and we look forward to doing business with you!

​

-Ken Carrick

Owner, Up to Code Plumbing

A Heartfelt Thank You To Past Employers

Up to Code Plumbing was built on a foundation of knowledge and experience gained from past employers. These employers taught us valuable lessons on how to treat staff and clients, as well as how not to. We extend a heartfelt thank you to them for their insights and guidance.

About

Your Plumber in Augusta, KS

If you live in Augusta, you don't have to settle for whoever happens to answer the phone. Up to Code Plumbing is a family-run plumbing company owned by Ken and Amanda Carrick. We drive out to Augusta from the Wichita area for homeowners and businesses who want the job done right. Ken is a licensed master plumber who has been plumbing since 2013.

Plumbing Services for Augusta Homes

Here's what Augusta customers most often call us for:

Drain and sewer cleaning: snaking stubborn clogs, cabling main lines, and camera inspections when a clog keeps coming back

Water heaters: repair and replacement of tank and tankless units, gas or electric

Leaks and water lines: finding and fixing leaks under sinks, behind walls, and along the main line

Fixtures: faucets, toilets, showers, and sinks. We're a Moen Install Pro and a Delta Certified Pro.

Gas lines: new lines for appliances and repairs on existing lines

Commercial Plumbing in Augusta

We also work with Augusta businesses on commercial plumbing, from restroom fixtures to water heaters and drain problems. If your business is having plumbing trouble, let us know what's going on and we'll find a time that works around your schedule.

What to Expect When You Call

When you reach out, tell us what's happening. We'll set up a visit during our regular hours: weekdays 7:30 AM–7 PM and weekends 9 AM–4 PM. Ken sometimes gets tied up on bigger jobs, so we'll be upfront about timing and keep you posted. When we arrive, we'll explain what we find and what it will take to fix it before we start.

Fair, Upfront Pricing

Augusta homeowners are often pleasantly surprised by our prices. We believe good plumbing shouldn't cost a fortune, so we tell you the price before we start. No surprises when the job is done.

Credentials You Can Check

We're BBB Accredited and Google Guaranteed. Seniors, military members, and first responders in Augusta get 10% off.

Augusta Plumbing FAQ

Do you really come out to Augusta?

Yes. Augusta is one of the towns we regularly serve, along with Wichita, El Dorado, Andover, and other nearby communities.

Can you replace a water heater at my Augusta home?

Yes. We repair and replace both tank and tankless water heaters, gas and electric.

How much will my plumbing repair cost?

It depends on the job, but we'll give you the price before any work begins. Many Augusta customers tell us they're surprised how reasonable it is, and seniors, military members, and first responders get 10% off.

Need a plumber in Augusta? Call (316) 400-7586, text (316) 333-5434, or Book Online, and we'll get you on the schedule.
